clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend who thinks peace requires good circumstances - awe at where this was actually written.
clips.caption:
He read it out loud on the show like it was just a passage he'd found somewhere - a guru's description of what full enlightenment feels like. No fear. No need to be validated. No one able to push your buttons, because you don't have any left to push.

Then he told you where it came from. He wrote it himself, in solitary confinement, in a cell they'd put a murderer in with him - a man who had just killed his last cellmate.

That's not a mantra written on a beach somewhere peaceful. That's a state of mind built in the worst room they could put him in.

clips.send: Someone sends this to the friend who's terrified of losing the one nice thing they own - unease at hearing the fear itself might be the problem.
clips.caption:
He bought a leather overcoat, handmade in Italy, for about $25,000 back in the nineties. He loved it so much he was afraid to wear it - worried about a scratch, a stain, a tear every time he put it on.

He wore it to dinner anyway, hung it on the coat rack by the door, and sat down to eat. When he got up to leave, it was gone. Stolen, right out of the restaurant.

His own words: what I feared most had come upon me. Not bad luck - the exact thing his attention had been locked onto the whole time.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to stop feeding a fear your full attention.

#subconscious #manifestation #awakening #innerwork #consciousness #kevintrudeau
